repair.availability_only: Presence in verified inventory is not actual inference or answer quality
repair.unchanged: Endpoint declaration/order, provider/model/prompt/engine identity, answer execution and authority remain unchanged

actual_availability.service_process_state: UNVERIFIED; request failure alone does not prove missing process or inventory
